name: My Little Princess
source: You’ll assume the role of a father who hasn't seen his daughter in years. She contacts you and tells you that she would like to visits you. You’ll have the chance to get to know your daughter better, build a special relationship and why not, maybe something more?​
translation: 你将扮演一位多年未见女儿的父亲。女儿联系你，说想来看看你。你有机会更深入地了解她，建立一段特殊关系，甚至……发展出更多可能？
